facts.text: I have chest pain.
It's on the left side of my chest.
I have a rash.
It's on my hands and feet: the palms and the soles.
There are several pale red, scaly, raised patches, about 3 to 8 millimetres across.

facts.item: how long the chest pain and rash have lasted
facts.text: The chest pain and the rash started three weeks ago.
I have a few small sores in my mouth.
I have lots of soft lumps on both sides of my neck.
They aren't tender.
I haven't had a fever.
I don't have a cough.
I'm not bringing up any phlegm.
I haven't lost weight.
I have allergic rhinitis (hay fever).
I smoke 5 to 10 cigarettes a day.
I drink socially.
Three months ago I had sex with a commercial sex worker.
I haven't travelled abroad.
I'm Japanese.
Three weeks ago a CT scan at a local hospital showed several spots in my left lung, and a contrast CT a week later showed them again.
I also had upper and lower endoscopies there, and they were normal.
The local hospital referred me here for further evaluation.

findings.result: Numerous soft, non-tender cervical lymph nodes bilaterally.

findings.name: skin examination
findings.result: Multiple pale red, scaly, nodular erythematous patches, 3–8 mm in size, on the palms and soles.

findings.name: complete blood count
findings.result: White blood cell count 10,600/μL; platelet count 621,000/μL.

findings.name: viral serology
findings.result: HIV antigen/antibody negative; hepatitis B negative; hepatitis C negative; HTLV-1 antibody negative.

findings.name: tumor markers
findings.result: CEA, SCC, CYFRA, Pro-GRP and NSE negative.

findings.name: autoimmune serology
findings.result: Rheumatoid factor negative; MPO-ANCA negative; PR3-ANCA negative.

findings.name: chest radiograph
findings.result: Blunting of the left costophrenic angle without discrete lung field opacities.

findings.name: neck Doppler ultrasonography
findings.result: Multiple enlarged lymph nodes with preserved hila.

findings.name: PET-CT
findings.result: High uptake in bilateral cervical, subclavicular, axillary, mediastinal and pelvic lymph nodes; no abnormal uptake elsewhere.

findings.name: cervical lymph node biopsy
findings.result: Lymphoid follicular hyperplasia, enlarged germinal centers, paracortical dilation, vascular proliferation and fibrosis. Immunostaining of the germinal centers negative for B-cell lymphoma; flow cytometry and genetic studies support reactive lymphadenopathy.

findings.name: bacterial and acid-fast bacillus smears and cultures
findings.result: Bacterial and acid-fast bacillus smears and cultures negative; PCR for Mycobacterium DNA negative.

findings.name: plain chest CT at the local hospital
findings.result: Multiple nodular shadows in the left lower lobe.

findings.name: contrast-enhanced thoracic CT
aliases: CT of the chest with contrast
findings.result: Multiple nodular shadows in the left lower lobe; slight enlargement of left mediastinal and bilateral axillary lymph nodes; small left pleural effusion.

gold.reasoning: 1. Primary or metastatic lung cancer — “metastatic lung cancer was suspected at the first visit.” 2. Malignant lymphoma — “immunostaining of the germinal centers was negative for B-cell lymphoma.” 3. Tuberculosis — “tests for Mycobacterium DNA using polymerase chain reaction” were all negative. 4. Mycosis — “β-D glucan was negative.” 5. Rheumatoid nodules — “rheumatoid factor was negative.” 6. Septic embolization — “bacterial culture smear ... were all negative.”

source_issues: No syphilis serology (treponemal or non-treponemal) is reported anywhere in the prompt; the diagnosis has to be reached from the history and examination, and a request for syphilis testing will be reported as unavailable.
The cervical lymph node is described as reactive; no specific staining for Treponema is reported.
notes: Index visit: the referral visit after three weeks of left chest pain and a palmoplantar rash (s001-s004, s007-s017); the two CT scans and the endoscopies at the local hospital (s005-s006) are earlier results, given with time.
s005: the clause 'metastatic lung cancer was suspected' is clinician reasoning at the earlier visit and is not used as a fact or finding.
Condom use with the sex worker is not stated, so the fact does not say whether the sex was protected.
